# Start Accelerating

Source: [6022](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6022); edited 2025-05-24. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Accelerating](../../api/actions/start-accelerating.md).

<a id="wiki-6022-n1"></a>

- Acceleration direction is normalized; rate is meters/second squared and may need to overcome gravity or surface friction.

<a id="wiki-6022-n2"></a>

- Actual attainable speed may be below Max Speed; archive says horizontal speed is capped at walking speed (5.5 m/s for most heroes by default).

<a id="wiki-6022-n3"></a>

- Archive gives stopping threshold as Max Speed^2 - Rate/62.5 and says the speed is measured along the acceleration direction.

Source limitations:

- Stopping-speed formula is surprising/dimensionally unclear; retain as an unverified archived claim rather than silently correcting or promoting it.

- Default hero speed is date-sensitive.
